Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the BTC-USD spot price on Coinbase reaches $150,000.00 or higher at any point before January 1, 2027 (00:00 UTC).
- "No": Wins if the BTC-USD spot price on Coinbase does not reach $150,000.00 at any point before January 1, 2027 (00:00 UTC).

Clarifications:
- "Reaches" means any single traded price (last trade price) of BTC-USD on Coinbase equals or exceeds $150,000.00 at any moment during the market's active window; an intraday wick suffices — the price does not need to close above the threshold.
